# Business Information
Name: Furniture Hub Dhangadhi (फर्निचर हब धनगढी)
Type: FurnitureStore / Retail
Location: Dhangadhi-3, Kailali, Sudurpashchim Pradesh, Nepal
Coordinates: 28.6833° N, 80.5833° E
Languages: Nepali (ne), English (en)
Currency: Nepali Rupee (NPR)

# What We Sell
Products:
- Sofas, sectionals, loveseats (सोफा, लभसिट)
- Beds, bedroom sets, mattresses (पलङ, बेडरुम सेट)
- Dining tables and chairs (डाइनिङ टेबल र कुर्सी)
- Office desks, office chairs (कार्यालय टेबल, कुर्सी)
- Coffee tables, side tables (कफी टेबल, साइड टेबल)
- Home décor: vases, mirrors, lamps (घर सजावट)
- Outdoor & garden furniture (बाहिरी फर्निचर)

Price Range: NPR 1,500 – NPR 2,50,000
